system.description:
Imprisoned in a glacier and still ruling. He understands patience better than anyone alive.

  • Patron boon: Once a day, fall into a deathlike sleep for up to an hour, waking on a trigger you name; while you sleep this way you need no air, food or water and can't be told from a corpse.

Allegiance: Lawful Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Levistus in the World of Arneyan wiki.
